stories.headline: Prediction: This Is How Much XRP Will Be Worth by the End of 2030

stories.headline: Fintech targets small-business niche that banks have spurned
stories.body: LoanBud CEO Burke Purcell is seeking to boost what he calls a "massively underserved" market: providing financing to the buyers of small businesses with price tags of just $100,000 to $350,000.

stories.headline: Barkin sees interest rate hikes ahead, but at a gradual pace
